integrity: All-size statements have direct mathematical proofs. Two included independent finite verification programs were executed on the recorded ranges. Results are not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Only one distinguished corner and rectangular grids with both side lengths at least two are covered. Counterexamples are not asserted planar. No optimal quantifier rank is given. The general amenability theorem of Arvind et al. establishes a broader decision criterion; the claimed contribution is the explicit grid-specific sharp boundary, with residual risk of prior specialized derivation.
title: One marked corner gives a sharp counting-logic boundary for rectangular grids
